_meta.description: Occultist subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: debuff control, spell vamp, dark survivability.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la durée des debuffs infligés de 1.2% et la MAG de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases debuff duration inflicted by 1.2% and MAG by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente le vol de sort de 1% et les dégâts des effets sur la durée de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases spell vamp by 1% and damage over time by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la résistance magique de 0.8% et l'esquive de 0.8% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases magic resist by 0.8% and evasion by 0.8% per level.
